subject: an open blank book containing a folded ocean
art_direction: 一本无字大书放在低处浅台上，书页翻成温柔蓝海，远方留出奶白光。
visible_description: 一本无字大书放在低处浅台上，书页翻成温柔蓝海，远方留出奶白光。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Place an open blank book on a low pale platform, with its thick pages turning into a contained blue ocean. Gentle waves follow the paper folds without spilling beyond the cover. Show page fibers and water translucency near the foreground, then soften the distant folds. Warm diffuse light and a quiet cream backdrop create thoughtful wonder without text or surrounding props. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
